evidence.answer_md: answer.md ll. 71–90: '# Unit 4: horizontal direction, including stationary wall-reflection frames.'
evidence.weight_pattern_en: Ch 3 (ball): column ramp [10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160, 170] on every row. Ch 4 (trail): negative column ramp [0, -20, -40, ..., -180] on every row (190 nonzeros, b1=0). At col 0/9 wall bounces where ball_col == trail_col, net sum is +10 / -10.

empirical.summary_en: h1[4] = +1.0 (right) or -1.0 (left) with 100% accuracy (380/380 frames, r = 1.000), including all 38 stationary wall-reflection frames where ball_col == trail_col.
empirical.summary_zh: h1[4] 在全部 380/380 帧（100%，r = 1.000）饱和至 +1.0（向右）或 -1.0（向左），含全部 38 个球与轨迹同列的墙壁反弹帧。

evidence.answer_md: answer.md ll. 92–111: '# Unit 5: descending versus ascending; a stationary row-8 frame means paddle bounce.'
evidence.weight_pattern_en: Ch 3 (ball): row ramp [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 70, 90] across all columns. Ch 4 (trail): negative row ramp [0, -10, -20, ..., -80, -90] across all columns, plus b1=+5 (180 nonzeros). At row-8 paddle bounce (ball_row == trail_row == 8), 70 - 80 + 5 = -5 (ascending).

empirical.summary_en: h1[5] = +1.0 (descending) or -1.0 (ascending) with 100% accuracy (380/380 frames, r = 1.000), including all 64 brick/paddle bounce frames where ball_row == trail_row.

evidence.answer_md: answer.md ll. 113–125: '# Four context-gated pairs of left/right comparisons. W2[0, 0:2] = [-1000, 1000]; b2[0:8] = -415; W3[0, 1] = 30.'

empirical.summary_en: Fires (h2[0] = +1.0) on 2/380 frames, otherwise -1.0; 100% exact match with (dx=+1 & dy=+1 & target < paddle), and 100% of firing frames select action 'left'.
